analytical_question: What innovation is proposed, and how could it create or displace value in this organization over 12 months?
general_et_finding: Agentic AI is a recombination of LLM capabilities and model-directed tool use, with commercial offerings rather than invention alone [S2, S3]. Innovation and commercialization can coexist. A universal breakthrough classification is not established: task-specific evidence against earlier automation is needed.

evidence.claim: Innovation requires meaningful difference and implementation; organizational novelty need not be world novelty.
evidence.notes: A specific SPS deployment or a universal breakthrough threshold.

evidence.claim: Separates model-directed tool use from fixed workflows; discusses complexity and compounding errors.
evidence.notes: Independent proof of superiority, reliability or savings at SPS; current tooling completeness.

evidence.claim: Commercial availability of an enterprise agent offering was announced in 2024.
evidence.notes: Verified customer ROI, broad adoption, current price, or SPS procurement.

evidence.claim: Public admissions information and staff appointment channels exist.
evidence.source_or_reference: [S4] NYU School of Professional Studies, Graduate Admissions. https://www.sps.nyu.edu/join/graduate-admissions.html
evidence.notes: Internal CRM, response delays, staff costs, AI deployment, lost applicants, or adoption posture.

evidence.claim: A pre-LLM conversational assistant was tested for pre-enrollment support at Georgia State.
evidence.source_or_reference: [S5] Lindsay C. Page and Hunter Gehlbach, How an Artificially Intelligent Virtual Assistant Helps Students Navigate the Road to College. https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.1177/2332858417749220
evidence.notes: Agentic-LLM superiority, NYU graduate applicant results, or transfer of effect sizes.

evidence.claim: Generated misinformation and human oversight require explicit controls.
evidence.source_or_reference: [S6] NIST, Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.AI.600-1
evidence.notes: Legal clearance, a guaranteed safe deployment, or quantified business disruption.

application_finding: The SPS proposal is a candidate incremental process innovation: it could connect inquiry handling to guided next steps and appointments while keeping the educational product intact. It is not an implemented SPS innovation on the supplied evidence. Model-directed tool choice would distinguish it from a fixed FAQ workflow; a tool call alone would not. A larger breakthrough interpretation would need demonstrated performance beyond the existing workflow.
organization_specific_finding: Business-Model Disruption Judgment: Moderate, conditional on effective use. Applicants could gain timely support and counselors could spend less time on repeated questions. Recruitment channels and support costs may change, while degrees, teaching and tuition remain the central offer. Some repetitive work and outsourced inquiry handling could lose value; reliable information curation could become more valuable. Internal systems and delays are scenario assumptions, not verified NYU facts.
contrary_evidence_or_limitations: A simpler FAQ or retrieval workflow may deliver most of the benefit with less integration effort.
Earlier student-support chatbots already existed [S5]; personalized communication alone is not evidence of a new technological frontier.
No SPS baseline costs, deployment evidence, conversion data or vendor contracts were supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the contextual interpretation; low confidence in the magnitude of savings or enrollment effects. Benefits require accuracy and manageable oversight costs.
value_opportunity_implication: Potentially expand support coverage and free staff capacity. These are hypotheses, not measured savings or new tuition revenue.
risk_governance_implication: Adopting too early could spread incorrect guidance or unauthorized actions. Failing to respond could leave an avoidable service gap, but competitor advantage has not been demonstrated. Staff must retain authority over consequential communication.
recommendation_management_implication: Ask for a bounded comparison with the current workflow before considering a pilot. The team should carry forward the process-innovation interpretation, not a claim that admissions or teaching can be replaced. Adoption owns go/no-go; Readiness owns integration; Diffusion and Landscape own market claims; Promethean owns broad significance.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess when cost and accuracy results are available.
Reconsider if competitors show sustained applicant-service benefits.
Reassess after a meaningful change in tool permissions or error patterns.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold a savings estimate and implementation claim until actual SPS workflow, review cost and permission data are available.
